create_FlatParameter: create a flat parameter that flattens and concatenates multiple original parameters for FSDP
create_FlatParamHandle: create a handle that manages a flat parameter including sharding and view management
create_HandleShardingStrategy: create a sharding strategy enum with FULL_SHARD, SHARD_GRAD_OP, NO_SHARD, and HYBRID_SHARD options
run_FlatParamHandle_shard: run the shard method to shard the flat parameter and allocate sharded storage
run_FlatParamHandle_unshard: run the unshard method to all-gather the flat parameter across ranks
